features.description: Share spawn lifecycle without changing legacy behavior
acceptance_criteria: Extract the shared authorization/admission/spawn lifecycle while preserving legacy errors and prefixes, including unprefixed admission errors.
Regression tests cover missing command, allowlist/confinement denial, success, and admission failure; no leaked workers or handles.
features.notes: Legacy denial, ownership and admission tests pass; shared parsing/spawn/publication extracted with unchanged error text.

features.description: Expose typed spawn through stdlib and VM
acceptance_criteria: Register Process.spawnProcessResult and _process_spawn_result with Result[ProcessHandle, ProcessError] metadata and wrapper.
NotFound, NotAllowed including narrowed subcommands and confinement, OS SpawnFailed, and BeginWorker/Complete failures return typed Err after capability checking.
Append __process_spawn_result without changing existing bytecode indices; focused compiler/VM dispatch and builtin type tests pass.
Successful Ok handle supports stdin write/close and cancellation; capability absence retains policy failure.
features.notes: Native dispatch, capability rejection, typed denials/OS failures and builtin type tests pass. Added scoped ProcessError VM ordinals because the existing bridge lacked them; append-only indices tested.

features.description: Lock down failure and lifecycle regressions
acceptance_criteria: Hermetic effects tests exercise each typed failure, including shutdown during admission completion; assert cleanup and distinguish no-child from child-started-then-cleaned-up cases.
CLI integration regression proves missing-command fallback prints started and after and exits zero; legacy spawn still aborts with its original error.
Targeted race tests for changed lifecycle tests pass without sleeps as synchronization.

features.description: Publish example and document process contracts
acceptance_criteria: examples/runnable/process_spawn_result.ail and manifest entry demonstrate typed fallback under IO,Process with the missing command allowlisted; expected output includes after.
Effects reference and streaming guide document the new API, literal allowlist keys, and WorkerHandleInvalid after normal reaping.
